name: AikidoDigital
description: AikidoDigital is a specialist platform built for Aikido organisations, associations and governing bodies. It manages members, dojos, grades, instructor records, attendance, documentation, renewals and reporting across an organisation's full hierarchy — from individual members and dojos to national governing bodies.

audience.audienceType: Aikido organisations, associations and governing bodies, organisation registrars, membership administrators, committees, affiliated dojos and instructors

featureList: Membership applications, renewals and expiry tracking
Dojo, venue and class schedule management
Hierarchical organisation structures (dojo, region, national body)
Kyu and Dan grading history and certificates
Membership, instructor and venue insurance documentation
Role-based access for registrars, administrators and committees
Two-factor authentication and administrative audit logs
keywords: aikido organisation management, aikido association software, aikido governing body software, dojo management software, aikido membership records, aikido grading records
